productName: VaultPilot — Direct-to-Disk Markdown & Marquee Web Clipper for Obsidian & Logseq

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of clipping web research and articles into your local Markdown vault getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With VaultPilot, Precision Article-to-Markdown Extraction runs right where you already work. Interactive Viewport Marquee & Selection Capture and Direct-to-Vault Local Filesystem Writing—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle clipping web research and articles into your local Markdown vault, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch VaultPilot in action: Strips navbars, popups, and tracking scripts automatically—producing deterministic Markdown with clean headings, code blocks, tables, and YAML frontmatter. Drag a marquee box around any architecture diagram, chart, or specific paragraph on a page to capture only the exact signal you need. Plus, saves `.md` files straight into your local Obsidian, Logseq, or Markdown folder on disk without bouncing through a third-party cloud bridge. Your internal wiki pages, competitive research, and personal knowledge base clips never leave your browser. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
